lines.translation: Taking me by the arm, He saves me and carries me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
God has rid me of my filth, and made me stainless and pure.
I have sought the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||3||
He Himself does, and causes everything to be done.
By His Grace, O Nanak, He saves us. ||4||4||17||
Basant, Fifth Mehl:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Behold the flowers flowering, and the blossoms blossoming forth!
Renounce and abandon your egotism.
Grasp hold of His Lotus Feet.
Meet with God, O blessed one.
O my mind, remain conscious of the Lord. ||Pause||
The tender young plants smell so good,
while others remain like dry wood.
The season of spring has come;
it blossoms forth luxuriantly. ||1||
Now, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga has come.
Plant the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.
It is not the season to plant other seeds.
Do not wander lost in doubt and delusion.
One who has such destiny written on his forehead,
Shall meet with the Guru and find the Lord.
O mortal, this is the season of the Naam.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਨ ਕਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੮॥
lines.transliteration: gun kahe naanak har hare har hare ||2||18||
lines.translation: Nanak utters the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||2||18||
Basant, Fifth Mehl, Second House, Hindol:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi ikatr milahu mere bhaaee dubidhaa door karahu liv laai ||
lines.translation: Come and join together, O my Siblings of Destiny; dispel your sense of duality and let yourselves be lovingly absorbed in the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕੇ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਜੋੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਸਫਾ ਵਿਛਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har naamai ke hovahu joRee guramukh baisahu saphaa vichhaai ||1||
lines.translation: Let yourselves be joined to the Name of the Lord; become Gurmukh, spread out your mat, and sit down. ||1||
In this way, throw the dice, O brothers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਨਹ ਲਾਗੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam japahu din raatee a(n)t kaal nah laagai peer ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night. At the very last moment, you shall not have to suffer in pain. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਤੁਮੑ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਸਾਜਹੁ ਸਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam dharam tumh chaupaR saajahu sat karahu tumh saaree ||
lines.translation: Let righteous actions be your gameboard, and let the truth be your dice.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜੀਤਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਖੇਲ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kaam krodh lobh mohu jeetahu aisee khel har piaaree ||2||
lines.translation: Conquer sexual desire, anger, greed and worldly attachment; only such a game as this is dear to the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਠਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਭਾਤੇ ਸੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: uth isanaan karahu parabhaate soe har aaraadhe ||
lines.translation: Rise in the early hours of the morning, and take your cleansing bath. Before you go to bed at night, remember to worship the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੜੇ ਦਾਉ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: bikhaRe daau la(n)ghaavai meraa satigur sukh sahaj setee ghar jaate ||3||
lines.translation: My True Guru will assist you, even on your most difficult moves; you shall reach your true home in celestial peace and poise. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: har aape khelai aape dekhai har aape rachan rachaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself plays, and He Himself watches; the Lord Himself created the creation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਸੋ ਜਿਣਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak guramukh jo nar khelai so jin baajee ghar aaiaa ||4||1||19||
lines.translation: O servant Nanak, that person who plays this game as Gurmukh, wins the game of life, and returns to his true home. ||4||1||19||
Basant, Fifth Mehl, Hindol:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree kudarat toohai jaanahi aur na doojaa jaanai ||
lines.translation: You alone know Your Creative Power, O Lord; no one else knows it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਝੈ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jis no kripaa karahi mere piaare soee tujhai pachhaanai ||1||
lines.translation: He alone realizes You, O my Beloved, unto whom You show Your Mercy. ||1||
I am a sacrifice to Your devotees.

lines.gurmukhi: ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੰਗ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: thaan suhaavaa sadaa prabh teraa ra(n)g tere aapaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Your place is eternally beautiful, God; Your wonders are infinite. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: teree sevaa tujh te hovai aur na doojaa karataa ||
lines.translation: Only You Yourself can perform Your service. No one else can do it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰੰਗੁ ਧਰਤਾ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat teraa soee tudh bhaavai jis no too ra(n)g dharataa ||2||
lines.translation: He alone is Your devotee, who is pleasing to You. You bless them with Your Love. ||2||
